hypotheses.alternative_explanation: Descriptor substitution (RDKit Wildman-Crippen MolLogP for Daylight CLOGP 4.72) and set differences move the score below threshold.
hypotheses.disproof_condition: R2 < 0.5 on the full archived set under the pre-registered scoring, or the Independent Verifier's re-run from archived inputs disagreeing beyond the pre-stated tolerance.
hypotheses.measurable_prediction: R2 >= 0.5 for predicted-vs-measured log solubility scored over all 1128 archived rows under the pre-registered rule.
hypotheses.proposed_explanation: The published Delaney (2004) ESOL equation, applied with RDKit descriptors to the archived 1128-compound set, predicts measured log solubility with R2 >= 0.5.
hypotheses.research_question: Can the published Delaney (2004) ESOL aqueous-solubility model be reproduced from the archived compound set?

hypotheses.alternative_explanation: Set composition (smaller processed set versus the paper's 2,874-compound training set) dominates the gap, not the descriptor swap.
hypotheses.disproof_condition: Pearson r <= 0.3 between absolute error and MolLogP, or no monotonic trend of error with hydrophobicity.
hypotheses.measurable_prediction: Per-compound absolute error rises with hydrophobicity: Pearson r > 0.3 between absolute error and MolLogP on the archived set.
hypotheses.proposed_explanation: Most of any RMSE gap versus the paper's reported standard error comes from the one known method difference: RDKit Wildman-Crippen MolLogP in place of Daylight CLOGP 4.72.
hypotheses.research_question: Can the published Delaney (2004) ESOL aqueous-solubility model be reproduced from the archived compound set?

hypotheses.alternative_explanation: Misses are uniform across structure classes, implicating a global bias rather than a domain limit.
hypotheses.disproof_condition: Fewer than 6 of the 10 filed worst misses fall in those classes, or the misses spread uniformly across classes.
hypotheses.measurable_prediction: At least 6 of the 10 filed worst misses are long aliphatics or fused polyaromatics by structure class.
hypotheses.proposed_explanation: The worst misses are dominated by long aliphatic chains and fused polyaromatics, outside a four-descriptor linear model's domain.
